name: orgos-reference
description: OrgOS — Organizational OS reference implementation (tenant-separated management framework)

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant demo events validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant acme validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant us-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant sg-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant ee-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant hk-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant au-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant tw-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant my-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant cn-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant ae-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant ru-demo validate && npm run orgos -- --tenant eu-demo validate && npm run validate:protocol:tenants && npm run orgos -- modules check --all && npm run orgos -- classification check
scripts.daily: npm run check && npm run orgos -- pipeline run daily
scripts.weekly: npm run check && npm run orgos -- pipeline run weekly
scripts.test:docker:smoke: docker compose -f deploy/test/docker-compose.yaml --profile smoke run --rm --build smoke
scripts.wire-console:smoke: npm run wire-console:build && playwright test e2e/wire-console.smoke.spec.ts && playwright test e2e/wire-console-webauthn.smoke.spec.ts --config=playwright.webauthn.config.ts && playwright test e2e/wire-console-oidc.smoke.spec.ts --config=playwright.oidc.config.ts
scripts.wire-console:release-check: npm run wire-console:test && npm run wire-console:smoke
scripts.steward-chat:smoke: vitest run tests/steward-chat-today.test.ts tests/steward-chat-auth.test.ts tests/steward-chat-stream.test.ts tests/steward-chat-events-stream.test.ts tests/steward-chat-flush.test.ts tests/chat-thread.test.ts tests/session-persist.test.ts tests/operator-dispatch-unified.test.ts tests/operator-runtime-shell.test.ts tests/operator-runtime-llm.test.ts tests/operator-runtime-tools.test.ts tests/operator-runtime-structured.test.ts tests/operator-runtime-telemetry.test.ts tests/mcp-auth-audit.test.ts tests/mcp-steward.test.ts tests/mcp-http.test.ts tests/mcp-abnormal.test.ts tests/rate-limit.test.ts tests/prod-auth-checklist.test.ts tests/prod-startup.test.ts tests/notifications-push.test.ts tests/csrf-guard.test.ts tests/chat-audit.test.ts tests/chat-rbac.test.ts tests/steward-chat-witness.test.ts tests/steward-chat-operator-stats.test.ts tests/steward-chat-abnormal.test.ts tests/package-release.test.ts
scripts.steward-chat:release-check: npm run steward-chat:smoke && npm run steward-chat:e2e && npm run steward-chat:webauthn-e2e && npm run operator-console:e2e
scripts.operator-console:build: npm run steward-chat:build && VITE_BASE=/wire/ VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-combined npm run build -w @orgos/wire-console
